result:
Work is complete and pushed. Summary:

**Root cause found:** `drizzle/meta/_journal.json` has been frozen at migration 0000 since it was first committed to the repo — confirmed via `git log` and by pulling drizzle-kit/drizzle-orm's actual published source. Since `readMigrationFiles()` only reads journal entries, `drizzle-kit migrate` never knew migrations 0001–0263 existed, which is why today's earlier run died replaying migration 0000 against an already-built schema.

**Audit results:** Cross-referenced all 261 real migration files against live DB state (compliance + platform schemas). Found 12 genuinely-missing migrations (0005, 0037, 0140, 0165, 0169, 0199, 0217, 0218, 0249, 0251, 0253, 0255) and applied all of them live via Supabase MCP, resolving a few real complications along the way (a table that had moved to a new `platform` schema mid-history, a stale orphaned `crm_activities` table with a completely different shape, an ivfflat memory limit, an unqualified enum type). Re-verified afterward: zero genuine mismatches remain.

**Fix:** Rebuilt the journal with all 261 real migrations and populated `drizzle.__drizzle_migrations` with 261 correct hash+timestamp rows, so future `bun run db:migrate` runs recognize everything as already-applied instead of blind-replaying.

**Projexa:** confirmed out of scope — its Supabase project has no `drizzle` schema at all.

Everything is documented in `ai-os/MIGRATION_DRIFT_AUDIT_2026-07-26.yaml`, and PR **#563** is open on compliance-tracker. One honest limitation flagged in the doc: bun/npm weren't available in this sandbox, so I couldn't literally re-run `bun run db:migrate` as a final smoke test — safety is established by direct inspection of drizzle-orm's actual migrate logic instead, and I noted that a session with a working bun environment should do that final confirmation run.
